errors: real input playthrough lost: rhythm, food=97, misses=10

investigation: Initial background run accumulated 10 misses after 97 fish; the next full foreground song passed (279 fish, 0 misses). A later run reproduced consecutive misses when another player took focus: queued inputs continued, but inputAt stopped advancing, with no external input callbacks. Unity InputSettings defaults to ResetAndDisableNonBackgroundDevices even when Application.runInBackground is true. QA now temporarily uses IgnoreFocus plus a dedicated virtual-keyboard filter, restoring settings afterward, and records background/disabled-keyboard frame counts. The release player keeps its normal pause-on-focus-loss behavior; these QA changes are excluded from its build.
finalEvidence: realtime-soak.json is the final isolated run, not the failed first attempt.
